_about: Narration for the demo film. Every figure traces to a file: lanes 39/13/2/15, 92 calls, 0 failed, 29.5 s, about $0.12 (docs/receipts/tokenfactory-full.json, data/sample-run.json); 3 of 3 planted conflicts and 4 removed tags (docs/receipts/tokenfactory-mini.json); the 7-versus-1 guard case (tests/fixtures/sample-run.2026-10-29.json, tests/numberguard.test.ts); -$2,625 on $10,500 (the drawer for A7K-7344990-0); 69 of 69 (the Scored test panel). 'say' is what the voice reads, 'cap' the burned-in caption.

sentences.say: Maya, a tiny importer, is owed tariff refunds. But one shipment in her file would leave her owing Customs twenty-six hundred twenty-five.
sentences.cap: Maya, a tiny importer, is owed tariff refunds. But one shipment in her file would leave her owing Customs $2,625.

sentences.say: Cape Refund Desk checks that file before the upload nobody can undo.
sentences.speak: Kayp Refund Desk checks that file before the upload nobody can undo.
sentences.cap: CAPE Refund Desk checks that file before the upload nobody can undo.

sentences.say: Her customs broker uploads it to Customs' portal, CAPE, and once it's accepted, nothing comes back out.
sentences.cap: Her customs broker uploads it to Customs' portal, CAPE, and once it's accepted, nothing comes back out.

sentences.say: Plain code does every dollar. Nemotron models, on Nebius Token Factory, tidy the messy data and explain.
sentences.cap: Plain code does every dollar. Nemotron models, on Nebius Token Factory, tidy the messy data and explain.

sentences.say: Maya runs her sixty-nine shipments live.
sentences.cap: Maya runs her 69 shipments live.

sentences.say: The fast model, Lightning, tidies every row. The thinking model, Ultra, reads the hard ones.
sentences.cap: The fast model, Lightning, tidies every row. The thinking model, Ultra, reads the hard ones.

sentences.say: Four groups. Thirty-nine ready to file, thirteen to fix first, two for her broker, fifteen Customs would reject.
sentences.cap: Four groups: 39 ready to file, 13 to fix first, 2 for her broker, 15 Customs would reject.

sentences.say: Ninety-two calls, none failed, in under a minute.
sentences.cap: 92 calls, none failed, in under a minute.

sentences.say: Open one Customs would reject, and you get its exact error.
sentences.cap: Open one Customs would reject and you get its exact error.

sentences.say: Customs finalized it a hundred thirty days ago, and claims close after eighty.
sentences.cap: Customs finalized it 130 days ago, and claims close after 80.

sentences.say: Now the shipment from the start. She paid ten and a half thousand dollars in tariff on it.
sentences.cap: Now the shipment from the start. She paid $10,500 in tariff on it.

sentences.say: But she underpaid over thirteen thousand in other duties, so claiming it may cost her twenty-six hundred twenty-five.
sentences.cap: But she underpaid over $13,000 in other duties, so claiming it may cost her $2,625.

sentences.say: Ultra explains why her broker decides first, and shows its reasoning.
sentences.cap: Ultra explains why her broker decides first, and shows its reasoning.

sentences.say: AI slips. One model wrote that seven entries expire today. The code counted one, and a check corrected it.
sentences.cap: AI slips. One model wrote that 7 entries expire today. The code counted 1, and a check corrected it.

sentences.say: In a ten-shipment test with three deliberately wrong notes, it caught all three, and code threw out four tags the AI invented.
sentences.cap: In a 10-shipment test with 3 deliberately wrong notes, it caught all 3, and code threw out 4 tags the AI invented.

sentences.say: She confirms it can't be undone, and exports the thirty-nine ready shipments in Customs' own format. The two that could cost her stay out.
sentences.cap: She confirms it can't be undone and exports the 39 ready shipments in Customs' own format. The two that could cost her stay out.

sentences.say: Her broker uploads it. We never ask for a login.
sentences.cap: Her broker uploads it. We never ask for a login.

sentences.say: Customs changes its rules, so the desk compares its live refund page with our July copy.
sentences.cap: Customs changes its rules, so the desk compares its live refund page with our July copy.

sentences.say: Four changes touch these checks, and Tavily, a second reader, confirms them.
sentences.cap: Four changes touch these checks, and Tavily, a second reader, confirms them.

sentences.say: Every run leaves a receipt, about twelve cents. Against answers we labelled by hand, the rules engine scores sixty-nine of sixty-nine.
sentences.cap: Every run leaves a receipt, about 12 cents. Against answers we labelled by hand, the rules engine scores 69 of 69.

sentences.say: Cape Refund Desk checks the file before the upload nobody can undo.
sentences.speak: Kayp refund desk checks the file before the upload nobody can undo.
sentences.cap: CAPE Refund Desk checks the file before the upload nobody can undo.

sentences.say: It's live, open source, and built for broker review.
sentences.cap: It's live, open source, and built for broker review.
